data.body: 462d regression fix (Option B): gated seed_projects_mapping_unit on _store_has_tickets() so fresh/empty stores are not seeded, preserving c927's fresh-store contract. Fixed 2 oracle tests to create a legacy ticket first. 462d oracle 8/8 GREEN; c927 bridge tests GREEN; mutation probe (negate guard) -> 3 RED = teeth hold. cef7 module-size fix redone (composer split as pure leaf, baseline byte-identical to origin/main). Amended 462d (Idde595c) + cef7 (I69137c1) via rebase, Change-Ids preserved; lint/typecheck/complexity clean; no src/rebar >800. Re-pushed: cef7=1749, 462d=1754 (stale votes cleared, re-running).
